function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Next Major U.S. Festival (after June 25 2026)** *Lollapalooza Chicago – Grant Park, Chicago, IL* | Detail | Information | |--------|-------------| | **Dates** | **August 11–14, 2026** | | **Location** | Grant Park, Chicago, Illinois | | **Typical Headliners** | (Past years have featured artists such as) Beyoncé, Taylor Swift, Kendrick Lamar, Billie Eilish, and many others. | | **Ticket Prices** | General Admission: $120–$200 (depending on seating tier). | | **Website** | [lollapalooza.com](https://www.lollapalooza.com) | | **Key Features** | • Multi‑stage music across several genres
• Food trucks & local vendors
• Art installations & interactive exhibits
• Free entry for Chicago residents on the first day (subject to capacity limits)
• Accessibility accommodations and safety protocols in place | --- ### Why Lollapalooza Chicago? - **Timing** – It falls in mid‑summer, making it the next big festival after the end of the summer season (post‑June 25). - **Popularity** – One of the largest music festivals in the country, drawing crowds from across the U.S. and internationally. - **Diversity** – Offers a wide range of musical styles, ensuring there’s something for almost everyone. - **Community Impact** – Generates significant economic activity for Chicago, supports local artists, and partners with community organizations for outreach programs. --- #### Quick Tips if You’re Planning to Attend 1. **Buy Early** – Tickets sell out fast; consider purchasing as soon as they become available. 2. **Plan Your Stages** – Check the official schedule to map out which stages you want to see. 3. **Accommodation** – Book hotels or Airbnb well in advance; the city fills up quickly during festival week. 4. **Transportation** – Use public transit or rideshare services; parking can be limited. 5. **Stay Hydrated** – Bring a reusable water bottle (many venues offer refill stations). Enjoy the music, the atmosphere, and the vibrant community spirit that Lollapalooza brings to Chicago!
